name: DHL Supply Chain - East Coast Center of Excellence (Project Empire) - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (30.4189,-81.5988) pointed at the JEA Northside power-plant tank farm on the Broward River, ~1.4 km W of the true site. Corrected via web research: Project Empire is at 10030/10300 Eastport Road, SW corner of Kraft & Eastport Rds, south of San Mateo Little League. Confirmed the large central N-S cross-dock warehouse at 30.4393,-81.5710 by Feb-2025 Street View showing the DHL building, office and entrance.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single divided main entrance off Eastport Road at the SW corner (SV Feb-2025 shows a median-split in/out drive with site signage). Fenced perimeter (chain-link visible in Street View). No public-road conflict.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance in Feb-2025 Street View or z20-21 satellite; modern fenced DC entrance with signage only.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard booth -> remote/kiosk check-in inferred (typical of recent DHL e-commerce builds).
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entrance drive is split by a landscaped median into separate inbound/outbound lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with continuous dock-door rhythm on BOTH long faces (east and west); ~50+ doors per face, 110 total estimate is low-confidence, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks split across two opposite building faces (east and west banks) - likely separate ship/receive operations; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Drop-yard trailer rows along the west fence line and additional rows on the east apron; 100+ trailers parked across the site.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and large interior truck-court turning area with ample unused paved width.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box ~690m N-S x ~290m E-W; roster cites 47.13-49.8 acres for the parcel.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 115 trailers counted across west drop row, west dock, east dock and east drop rows in Feb-2025 imagery.
